title: Nvidia invests $2B in Nebius

sources.quote: NVIDIA will invest $2 billion in Nebius, reflecting NVIDIA's confidence in Nebius's business and unique depth of engineering expertise across the full AI technology stack.
In Q1, we raised $6.3 billion, including the $2 billion equi-ty investment from NVIDIA, and $4.3 billion from convertible securities at favourable rates.

explain: Nvidia invested $2 billion in Nebius as part of a partnership for Nebius to deploy more than 5 gigawatts of Nvidia systems by 2030. Much of Nebius's spending goes to Nvidia hardware, so the money partly returns to Nvidia.
